## Où j'en suis
Postmortem action item: re-ingest the events lost on 12/11 (14:10–17:40 UTC). `cmd/replay` was built with dry-run mode, per-partition ordering, a rejects file, and a hard-coded topic allowlist. The dry run on the real archive succeeded: 18,442,107 events to replay, 3,118 schema v2 lines written to `s3://kestrel-raw-events/replay-rejects/`. PR #233 is open with Daniel as reviewer; the real replay has not been run.

- [en-cours] Waiting on Daniel's review of PR #233.
- [prochaine-étape] After review: run the real replay into `events.replay.v3`, then aggregator `--backfill` for 2026-11-12.
- [prochaine-étape] User will give Rachel the ETA for Fernhill and Orbitly by Friday (user explicitly declined a drafted reply).
- [essai-raté] Dry run job `replay-dryrun-1` was OOMKilled at 2 GiB with `--batch 50000`; fixed with `--batch 5000` (~310 MiB peak), no memory limit change.
- [essai-raté] `TestStreamWindow_OrderWithinPartition` failed due to 4 concurrent workers interleaving one partition; fixed by splitting workers by partition key (commit `4e2d9b7`).
- [décision] No age cutoff, replay everything, target only `events.replay.v3`, never produce to `events.v3` from this tool (source: t05).
- [décision] Batch size 5k, don't touch the namespace memory quota (source: t13).
- [décision] Malformed lines go to a rejects file in the bucket, no silent skips (source: t15).
